review_scope: Selected eclipse interpretation in hash-verified cached QLP SAP, with bounded follow-up where decisive.
evidence: The S13 1669.05 broad selected deficit follows a 1667.572–1668.676 d gap and flux reset. S39 has multiple rapidly alternating dip/bright flags from 2368.93 to 2373.81 in a jagged segment after a 2368.010–2368.489 d gap. interpretation: The selected events are positively explained by unstable baseline, gap and common-timing effects rather than repeated isolated eclipses.
limitations: No reliable clock or depth is established from these flags; this does not rule out another binary event.
